cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: I Know How to Win This
cards.instruction: Perform mastery of the rules, odds, and consequences while improvising every decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll open with this horse in the lake. Watch your old teacher; I taught you to check the whole board before choosing a move.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There aren't horses. That's the scoring marker.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You identified it without my help this time. We establish the score first, so put it in the lake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not allowed to move it. We both start at zero.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly; zero gives us equal odds. Leave it there and hand me a playing piece instead. I'll demonstrate the opening once you've pointed out where the lake starts.

reason: Connect the specific tuition to A present pursuit. Make B correction or practical objection change A actual demand, and replace detached final explanations with an action or answer A needs.
